dependencies.en: The package declares a Python and Node.js host. Check its dependency lock for supported versions and any additional rendering tools.

dependencies.en: Use the package dependency lock and setup/check instructions. Check existing tools first, install only missing requirements and verify a preview.

en: A complete 59.25-second paper-scroll product or brand narrative driven by current-production copy, brand and image/video inputs.
zh: A complete 59.25-second paper-scroll product or brand narrative driven by current-production copy, brand and image/video inputs.

en: The documented output is 1920 × 1080, 60 fps; default demo duration is 59.25 seconds.
Use the actual package parameter bounds; extra materials do not automatically create extra scenes.
Unreviewed portrait conversion, arbitrary scene reordering, or declaring unrelated diagram semantics without adapting and reviewing them.
zh: 已声明输出为 1920 × 1080，60 fps；默认样片 59.25 秒。
按实际包的参数边界制作；增加素材不会自动增加场景。
